title: Video Player in Dealer Mode
desc: Refer to CFTS012-696, CFTS022-2237 and 'Showroom Demo Mode HMI Logic and Flow' for more requirements related to Video Player in Dealer Mode. [Cross-ref resolved from CFTS012 Dealer SWRA]: The HU shall load and play the Demo Video (DEAL-026). The Dealer Mode shall have the option to not allow the user to exit the Video; if set, once the video starts it only exits when the video finishes playing (DEAL-028/028-01), and the video shall continue to loop play if set to repeat (DEAL-028-02). The Dealer Demo shall not play over ignition cycles (DEAL-030). Clear personal data shall remove the Demo Video and disable the functionality in Dealer Mode (DEAL-027/027-01).
